signIn.title: Welcome to Afriklang recording
signIn.intro: Sign in with the Google account that uses the email address your invitation was sent to.
signIn.why: This is how we make sure the invitation reaches the right person. Your Google email must be verified and match the invitation.
signIn.invitationDetected: Your invitation was detected. Sign in to use it.
signIn.error: We could not open Google sign-in. Please try again.
signIn.notConfigured: Developer note: sign-in is not configured. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.

failure.titleAccount: This Google account does not match
failure.titleLink: We could not use this invitation
failure.titleRetry: We could not check your invitation
failure.otherAccountHint: Your invitation is still saved. Sign in with the right account to continue.
failure.contact: Need help? Contact the Afriklang team.

brokenLink.title: This invitation link is incomplete
brokenLink.body: Part of the link seems to be missing, often because it was cut when copied. Open the link directly from your invitation email by tapping it.
brokenLink.help: If it still does not work, ask the Afriklang team to send you a new invitation.

notLinked.title: Open your invitation link
notLinked.body: Open the link from your invitation email to get started.
notLinked.lost: Cannot find the email? Contact the Afriklang team and we will send you a new invitation.

home.intro: Here are the campaigns you are invited to.
home.errorTitle: We could not load your campaigns
home.emptyBody: When the Afriklang team adds you to a campaign, it will appear here.
